verdict.detail: Hold everything until the official Mainz XI publishes about an hour before the lock, then execute in one block. Elversberg v Mainz is the Friday evening game, so its team sheet lands just before the deadline — and all four live decisions (sell Schwolow, buy Zentner, sell Deman, buy da Costa) are Mainz decisions that the sheet resolves at a stroke. Both buys are manager asks, which can be accepted instantly, and both sells go back to Kickbase, which is instant too. Nothing is gained by pre-committing this morning and a great deal is lost by guessing wrong. The balance is positive, the squad fields its only legal formation, and no deadline bites before this evening. The decisive run is the one that fires shortly before the lock, after the sheet is out.

sell.reason: Deman is the clear sale and the premise has not weakened. Two separate 29.10 sources name his replacement rather than him: the Comunio preview lists him under the walking-wounded with a tendon irritation in the foot and says Schmetgens should replace him at left-back, and the Bundesliga.com matchday page gives Werder's back four with Schmetgens in that slot and no mention of Deman at all. But he is a fielded defender, so the sale cannot fire until a defender has landed. Schwolow is the conditional second sale and he is not a sale on merit — he has started the last four matchdays and is the best keeper this squad has owned this season. He only becomes a zero if Zentner is actually named, which is precisely what the evening team sheet settles. If Zentner is not named, keeping Schwolow is the correct outcome, not a failure.

Probable, not confirmed — so wait for the sheet. Da Costa is the defender leg and his bench risk hardened overnight, which is the one real change this run. The bid stays at market value rather than at the ask, because the ask has sat unsold for four days and manager asks in this league clear in the low single digits over value. killed_this_run.name: INSTRUMENT TRAP — a ligainsider PLAYER PROFILE can render a stale Angeschlagen icon and a truncated news list; cross-check the league-wide Verletzte table and the CLUB page before acting
killed_this_run.why: MEASURED 29.10 02:45Z ON PROFILE 20278 (Yannik Engelhardt). Call Ssb5k11, written at 00:45Z, reported that profile 20278 read status FIT, 0% Verletzt/Gesperrt, newest item 27.10.2026 "Engelhardt kehrt gegen Wolfsburg zurueck" with the fit icon. Two hours later the SAME URL rendered: status icon ANGESCHLAGEN, the literal string "Fehlt seit 5 Tagen", and a newest item of 22.10.2026 21:22 "Engelhardt muss gegen Monaco frueh runter" — with NO 27.10 item anywhere in the nine items on news page 1. The two reads cannot both be a faithful view of the same page. WHAT THIS IS NOT: it is not evidence the 00:45Z run invented the item. Freiburg really did play Wolfsburg in the DFB-Pokal 2. Runde on 28.10.2026 and won 3:2, so a 27.10 return-preview is precisely the item that should exist, and the fetch that missed it also reported the article body sitting behind the Plus/ad-block overlay. THE FAILURE MODE, AND IT CUTS BOTH WAYS: a ligainsider player profile serves (a) a STATUS ICON that is not re-cleared when a player returns — here it is still anchored to the 22.10 Monaco knock while the player's own counter reads 0% Verletzt/Gesperrt (0/765 minutes missed), which is self-contradictory on its face — and (b) a NEWS LIST that can be truncated or cached so the newest items are simply absent. So a profile can show a player as hurt when he is fit (this case), and by the same mechanism can fail to show a fresh injury on a player it still marks fit. A PROFILE ICON IS NOT A FITNESS VERDICT. THE RULE: never resolve a fitness question on a profile icon alone. Require at least one of (1) the league-wide /bundesliga/verletzte-und-gesperrte-spieler/ table — Engelhardt is NOT on it; Freiburg's entries are Muslija, Ogbus, Yilmaz only — or (2) the CLUB page's voraussichtliche Aufstellung with its own Letzte-Aktualisierung stamp, or (3) a dated match report. And ALWAYS read the profile's own Verletzt/Gesperrt percentage: a 0% counter beside an Angeschlagen icon means the icon is stale, and that single cross-check would have settled this in one read. RELATED AND DISTINCT: At1mbjl is the Engelhardt SOURCE trap (article 413238 dated 12.05.2026, last season). This entry is the INSTRUMENT trap — the page furniture, not the article date — and the two must not be merged. COMPANION TO Aexeh9d, which established the mirror-image rule that a club page OMITTING a player is not evidence he is dropped.
